messages:
Pri (product): Quick sync: enterprise sales ask — guaranteed on-demand full trace retrieval from an error tile with SLA and billing visibility. Need to decide scope + pricing.
Zack (eng): Two tradeoffs: always-index handles (steady-cost) vs write-on-error pointers (cheaper until audit hits). Reconstruction path will read segment store; cold reads expensive.
Maya (sre): Ops constraints: must have quotas, throttles, and audit trail. Also require redaction pass before export. Suggest default: pointer-on-error + paid add-on for guaranteed handles + priority reconstructions.
Ivy (acct): Customers want exportable, line-item proof to reconcile disputes. We should propose 1) free pointer+CSV mapping, 2) paid SLA for 30s fetch 95% of the time. Contracts needed.
Rex (design): UX: error card shows "Trace handle" pill; if not present show "Request full trace" with estimated cost/time. Modal should show audit metadata and redaction status. Do not block primary error list rendering.
Pri (product): Proposed prioritization for next cycle: A) implement pointer index for errors (beta), B) cost & invoice mapping export, C) priority reconstruct for paid tenants. Launch gates: pointer visible, CSV export works, reconstruct audit present.
Zack (eng): Rough plan: pointer index + API ~1 sprint. CSV pipeline + UI export ~1 sprint. Priority reconstruct infra + redaction ~2 sprints + spike. Need backfill window plan and sample dataset for spike.
Maya (sre): Ops playbook items: per-org concurrent job cap (default 3), background backfill rate-limit, alert on reconstruct cost >2x baseline, immutable audit logs, revocation flow.
Ivy (acct): Pricing: suggest tiered fees: free pointers, $X/month for guaranteed handles, $Y per priority reconstruct (credits model). Legal needs export audit clause.
Pri (product): Risks: PII exposure, cost spikes, user confusion when reconstruct fails. Mitigations: redaction pipeline, canary on Dedicated, clear UX failure states, and billing guardrails.
Zack (eng): Action items: will open RFC with schema for pointer, cost model, reconstruct API, and canary plan. Need eng+ops spike to validate 30s SLA feasibility.
Rex (design): I'll mock error-card pill + reconstruct modal with incremental span streaming and explicit audit info.
Maya (sre): I'll draft ops runbook and SLO proposals: target 95% success within 30s for paid canary; default 60s for general cohort.
automations-bot: Reminder: RFC review scheduled for 1723520000."
